newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe, USX to boost steel sheet output in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Kobe, USX to boost steel sheet output in U.S..

text.p: Kobe Steel Ltd and the U.S. Steel Group of USX Corp said they are planning to boost output of galvanised steel sheets in the United States.
The move is in response to high demand for the corrosion-resistant steel products for cars.
The firms are studying details of a second hot-dip galvanised steel sheet product line at their joint venture PRO-TEC Coating Co in Ohio, they said in a joint statement.
The new line will have a yearly production capacity of 400,000 tonnes, they said.
The venture, which started output in 1993, currently has an annual production capacity of 600,000 tonnes of galvanised steel sheet, they said.
The new line will make high-quality coated steel sheet products to be supplied primarily to U.S. carmakers and to Japanese carmakers' plants in the United States, they said.
Construction of the new production line could begin as early as February and the line could start operations in the third quarter of 1998 in time for 1999 car models, they said.
